metadata.title: High-Fashion Editorial Portrait with Voluminous Texture

retrievalProfile.description: A sophisticated, desaturated studio portrait featuring a subject with extremely voluminous, wind-swept hair and sharp tailoring against a clean gradient background.
excludeWhen: vibrant or saturated color palettes are required
casual or outdoor settings are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of a woman with dramatic, expansive, textured hair that fills the upper frame. She wears a structured, dark, single-button blazer with no shirt underneath, complemented by a gold chain necklace. The lighting is soft but directional, creating subtle shadows that define the facial structure and the fabric's sheen. The color palette is heavily desaturated, leaning toward cool grays and muted skin tones, with a clean, light-gray gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the wild, organic texture of the hair and the sharp, geometric lines of the blazer.
The subject's direct, confident gaze acting as the central focal point amidst the chaotic hair.
The balance of the subject positioned on the left with negative space on the right for typographic elements.
The tonal harmony between the cool-toned skin and the neutral gray background.
coreInvariants: Voluminous, textured hair as a primary framing element.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately two-thirds of the horizontal frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the sharp 'V' of the blazer neckline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves upward through the expansive hair, then follows the line of the blazer down to the hand in the pocket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the right side of the frame, providing a clean area for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and desaturated mid-tones in the background and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black in the blazer and eye makeup.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle metallic gold in the necklace and warm highlights in the hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the dark blazer and the light background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to grays, blacks, and muted flesh tones

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space to the right of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or tracking for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure and professional tone.
Modern geometric sans-serif that handles wide tracking well.
Classic geometric proportions that match high-fashion aesthetics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with extremely voluminous, messy blonde-brown hair, wearing a sharp black blazer and a gold chain. Use a desaturated color grade and a light gray gradient background. Position her to the left, leaving the right side empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the empty space on the right. Use wide tracking and a dark gray color.

verificationChecks: Is the hair the most prominent textural element?
Is the color palette sufficiently desaturated?
Is the text right-aligned in the negative space?
Does the blazer have a sharp, tailored appearance?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
Ensure the text content is generic or placeholder

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and negative space

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the subject is positioned to the left.
Check that the hair fills a significant portion of the upper frame.
Verify the text is clean, sans-serif, and right-aligned.
Ensure the overall mood is sophisticated and cool-toned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(High-Fashion Female) + Attribute(Voluminous Messy Hair) + Attire(Tailored Blazer) + Setting(Neutral Studio) + Color(Desaturated/Cool) + Layout(Rule of Thirds with Right-Aligned Typography)
